Our Little Memory Garden 🌷

Every picture is a little flower in our garden.

✏️ How to swap a photo
  1. Your six pictures are already built into this file. Frames count left to right, top to bottom.
  2. To swap one, make a folder named photos next to index.html and save the new picture there as photo1.jpg to photo6.jpg. It replaces that frame.
  3. Change the captions in the CAPTIONS list at the top of the script.
  4. Before you share the link, set SHOW_OWNER_TIPS to false to hide this note.
